items.title: Iran says it destroyed US military radar in Bahrain in retaliatory strike
items.summary: First direct attack on US military installations for months was in response to US airstrike on communications tower Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says it has targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain in response to a US airstrike on a communications tower in Sirik overlooking the strait of Hormuz. It is Iran’s first direct attack on US military installations for months. “This is a serious warning to the aggressor enemy to end its aerial mischief…

items.title: Security Council LIVE: Fragile Gulf calm tested as threats to Hormuz shipping mount
items.summary: Nearly nine months after Israeli and US strikes on Iran set off a regional war, the Gulf remains on a knife edge. Iran has all but closed the Strait of Hormuz, which carried a fifth of the world’s oil before the conflict. Attacks on shipping are rising, and efforts to stop a return to full-scale fighting have yet to produce a deal. The Security Council meets shortly at Bahrain’s request to discuss the threat to regional and maritime security. Follow live below – and for…

ai.sum: Iran has nearly closed the Strait of Hormuz and attacks on shipping are rising, as the UN Security Council meets at Bahrain's request.
